title: H-2DGS: Height-Field Gaussian Splatting for Sharp and Deformable Neurosurgical Surface Reconstruction
title_zh: H-2DGS：用于清晰可变形神经外科表面重建的高度场高斯泼溅

paragraphs.en: Neurosurgical navigation commonly presents magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as 2D slices, making it difficult to relate the anatomy in those slices to the cortical surface observed through the surgical microscope. We seek a common 3D visualization that combines a photorealistic reconstruction of the exposed cortex during tumor surgery with whole-brain MRI context and diffusion tractography pathways. This requires the reconstructed cortex to form a clear boundary around the brain anatomy rather than a diffuse volume that obscures internal structures. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reproduce observed views but, under limited surgical view coverage, may distribute opacity through a thick and geometrically ambiguous band. We introduce height-field 2D Gaussian Splatting (H-2DGS), a three-stage pipeline that concentrates a robust 3DGS reconstruction, fuses its depth into a shared truncated signed distance field (TSDF) surface, and represents that surface with curved, surface-oriented Gaussian primitives. Separate height, color, and opacity bases provide local geometry and appearance, while a neighbor-transition objective coordinates overlapping patches. The explicit surface further supports postoperative alignment: MRI-derived depth deforms the reconstruction, and tracked-color supervision with alternating optimization preserves its appearance. Across five real neurosurgical cases, H-2DGS gives low multi-view depth inconsistency, a compact 7.97 MB representation, and interactive rendering at 29–42 ms per frame. The resulting sharp, deformable surface integrates clearly with tractography and MRI anatomy, including a postoperative resection cavity.
paragraphs.zh: 神经外科导航通常以二维（2D）切片的形式呈现磁共振成像（MRI），这使得切片中的解剖结构难以与手术显微镜下观察到的皮质表面建立联系。 我们寻求一种通用的三维可视化方法，将肿瘤手术中暴露皮质的光度真实感重建与全脑 MRI 背景 以及弥散纤维束成像通路相结合。 这要求重建的皮质在大脑解剖结构周围形成清晰的边界，而不是一个遮挡内部结构的弥散体积。 传统的三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）能够再现已观察到的视图，但在手术视角覆盖有限的情况下，可能在厚且几何上含糊的条带中分布不透明度。 我们提出高度场二维高斯泼溅（H-2DGS），这是一个三阶段流程：先获得稳健的 3DGS 重建，再将其深度融合到共享的截断符号距离场（TSDF）表面中，最后用弯曲的、面向表面的高斯基元来表示该表面。 独立的高度、颜色和不透明度基提供局部几何与外观，同时邻居过渡目标函数协调相互重叠的面片。 显式表面还支持术后对齐：MRI 衍生的深度使重建发生形变，而结合交替优化的追踪颜色监督保持其外观。 在五个真实神经外科病例中，H-2DGS 实现了低多视角深度不一致性、紧凑的 7.97 MB 表示，以及每帧 29–42 毫秒的交互式渲染。 得到的锐利、可形变的表面能与纤维束成像和 MRI 解剖结构（包括术后切除腔）清晰地融合在一起。

paragraphs.en: Medical visualization plays a central role in the interpretation, communication and education of neuroanatomy and tractography. Interactive visualization is important in, e.g., neurosurgical planning, as it enables users to explore anatomical structures and fiber pathways. Modern neurosurgery uses dedicated navigation systems for surgical planning, intraoperative localization, and postoperative assessment. These systems commonly present registered magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as orthogonal 2D slices [ 13 , 6 ] . The slices contain rich tissue information, but they do not resemble the exposed cortical surface seen through the surgical microscope. Consequently, understanding where a visible vessel, sulcus, or resection boundary lies within the MRI volume requires a mental correspondence between two very different views. This separation increases cognitive load, and the missing 3D spatial context makes the relationship less intuitive [ 3 ] .

paragraphs.en: We instead aim to place the complementary information in one 3D scene. Microscope video supplies the current color and fine surface landmarks of the exposed cortex. MRI supplies the surrounding whole-brain tissue context, while diffusion MRI tractography exposes subcortical pathways that are not visible at the surface. A photorealistic 3D reconstruction can connect what the surgeon sees to these internal structures under continuous viewpoint changes: the cortex provides the visible outer layer, the MRI-derived model locates that layer within the brain, and tractography shows the structures beneath it. paragraphs.en: Creating this visualization is not only a registration problem; it first requires an appropriate representation of the visible layer. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 11 ] is attractive because it reconstructs realistic appearance, renders rapidly, and exposes primitives that can be manipulated. It has consequently been adopted for static and deforming surgical scenes [ 9 , 10 , 16 , 7 , 17 , 22 ] . However, each conventional 3D Gaussian distributes opacity through a volume. With the narrow camera trajectories typical of microscope video, Gaussians at several depths can explain the same training pixels. The model may therefore look realistic from observed views while forming a thick, blurry, or fragmented density band elsewhere. When tractography is rendered beneath this band, fibers can be obscured by or visually embedded in the reconstructed cortex, so the boundary between visible surface and subcortical anatomy becomes ambiguous.

paragraphs.en: We address this representation gap with H-2DGS, which progressively converts a robust volumetric reconstruction into a geometrically sharp yet photorealistic surface. Stage I first uses conventional 3DGS to establish appearance without prematurely imposing a fragile surface. Stage II then measures the spread of density along camera rays and contracts it toward the visible boundary. Multi-view depth from this concentrated model is fused into a truncated signed distance field (TSDF), providing a shared surface rather than unrelated per-view estimates. Stage III discards the volumetric Gaussians and places curved height-field primitives on the TSDF zero level set. The height field lets each patch follow local cortical curvature, separate color and opacity bases retain spatially varying texture, and neighbor-transition optimization coordinates overlapping patches.

paragraphs.en: The common 3D view must also remain meaningful when anatomy changes. Brain motion and tissue removal alter the relationship between the reconstructed surface and MRI [ 6 ] ; after resection, the cavity can also invalidate vessel-based correspondence. Depth determines the target shape, while tracked color supervision, overlap regularization, and alternating geometry–appearance updates prevent the alignment from erasing the photorealistic cortical texture. Preoperative vessel-guided alignment is retained only as a downstream use of the reconstructed surface.

paragraphs.en: Standard 3DGS represents a scene with anisotropic volumetric Gaussians optimized through differentiable alpha compositing [ 11 ] . Several alternatives strengthen its geometric prior. 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) replaces ellipsoids by oriented disks and uses ray–splat intersection to obtain a more surface-like representation [ 8 ] . 3D Half-Gaussian Splatting (3D-HGS) splits primitives with learned planes to sharpen discontinuities [ 15 ] , while Quadratic Gaussian Splatting (QGS) models local geometry with second-order surfaces [ 14 ] . These approaches initialize their designed primitives directly from an input point cloud. Under limited view coverage, the source geometry can itself be weakly constrained. H-2DGS instead first concentrates a robust volumetric reconstruction, fuses its multi-view depth into a shared TSDF, and only then initializes curved surface charts. paragraphs.en: Neural and Gaussian representations have been applied to static and deforming surgical scenes [ 18 , 17 , 22 ] . Most of these methods prioritize view synthesis or temporal tissue motion. Cross-modal methods connect intraoperative imagery to preoperative anatomy through inverse rendering or coupled meshes [ 4 , 5 ] . Our focus is complementary: we construct a sharp, compact cortical boundary from limited microscope views, use it as a substrate for tractography, and directly deform this renderable surface toward postoperative geometry.

paragraphs.en: Directly fitting surface-oriented splats from the sparse input point cloud is brittle in this setting: the same limited camera coverage that creates 3DGS thickness also leaves the initial geometry weakly constrained. We therefore separate appearance acquisition from surface construction. Stage I obtains a robust photometric reconstruction with flexible volumetric Gaussians. Stage II makes this reconstruction a reliable geometric proxy by contracting its density along observed rays without changing the primitive type. Stage III fuses the resulting multi-view depths into one surface and replaces the volumetric model with curved height-field patches. Thus each stage has a distinct purpose: bootstrap appearance, localize geometry, and encode an explicit surface.

Our optimization therefore combines three mechanisms with distinct roles. paragraphs.en: We evaluate five MRI cases using real neurosurgical videos: three preoperative cases and two postoperative cases. For each case, we select the continuous segment of the surgical video with the most comprehensive viewpoint coverage and uniformly sample frames from the original segment, resulting in a continuous sequence of 60–80 images for training. The data were shared under the approved data-sharing agreement between the participating institutions. All patients provided written informed consent for the use of their data for research purposes. All experiments run on an NVIDIA RTX 3050 GPU with 4 GB memory, 32 GB system memory, and an Intel i7-12700H CPU. H-2DGS uses 2,400 primitives per case, with 50 color and 20 opacity bases per primitive. We compare against 2DGS [ 8 ] , 3D-HGS [ 15 ] , and QGS [ 14 ] , trained with their released default settings.

paragraphs.en: Together with the proposed three-stage pipeline, H-2DGS produces a photorealistic reconstruction of the cortical surface with a sharp geometry and well-defined boundary. This explicit surface enables direct integration with subcortical tractography and whole-brain MRI context without the internal anatomy being obscured by diffuse volumetric opacity. Compared with the baseline approaches, H-2DGS achieves substantially better geometric generalization across viewpoints: it consistently maintains a localized cortical surface in uncovered views and obtains lower multi-view depth inconsistency across the five cases ( Tabs. 1 and 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 结合所提出的三阶段流程，H-2DGS 对皮层表面实现了具有锐利几何和清晰边界的照片级真实感重建。 这一显式表面能够与皮层下纤维束追踪及全脑 MRI 上下文直接集成，而内部解剖结构不会被弥散的体积不透明度所遮挡。 与基线方法相比，H-2DGS 在跨视角的几何泛化方面表现显著更好：它在未覆盖视角下始终能保持局部化的皮层表面，并在五个病例上获得了更低的多视角深度不一致性（见表 1 和表 6）。

sents.en: Together with the proposed three-stage pipeline, H-2DGS produces a photorealistic reconstruction of the cortical surface with a sharp geometry and well-defined boundary.
sents.zh: 结合所提出的三阶段流程，H-2DGS 对皮层表面实现了具有锐利几何和清晰边界的照片级真实感重建。

sents.en: This explicit surface enables direct integration with subcortical tractography and whole-brain MRI context without the internal anatomy being obscured by diffuse volumetric opacity.
sents.zh: 这一显式表面能够与皮层下纤维束追踪及全脑 MRI 上下文直接集成，而内部解剖结构不会被弥散的体积不透明度所遮挡。

sents.en: Compared with the baseline approaches, H-2DGS achieves substantially better geometric generalization across viewpoints: it consistently maintains a localized cortical surface in uncovered views and obtains lower multi-view depth inconsistency across the five cases ( Tabs. 1 and 6 ).
sents.zh: 与基线方法相比，H-2DGS 在跨视角的几何泛化方面表现显著更好：它在未覆盖视角下始终能保持局部化的皮层表面，并在五个病例上获得了更低的多视角深度不一致性（见表 1 和表 6）。

paragraphs.en: The clear geometry of H-2DGS also provides a suitable foundation for deformation. Its surface primitives retain sufficient geometric flexibility to represent substantial morphological changes, allowing deformation objectives to be defined directly on the primitive parameters and fitted to a target geometry. The geometric and rendering flexibility of H-2DGS is verified in the postoperative case, where the fitting process is separated into depth-fitting and appearance-preservation stages. The postoperative experiment demonstrates that this strategy can accommodate a pronounced geometric discrepancy while preserving the photorealistic appearance of the original reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: H-2DGS 清晰的几何结构也为形变提供了合适的基础。 其表面基元保留了足够的几何灵活性，能够表示大幅度的形态变化，从而可以直接在基元参数上定义形变目标，并拟合到目标几何。 H-2DGS 的几何与渲染灵活性在术后案例中得到了验证，其中拟合过程被分为深度拟合与外观保持两个阶段。 术后实验表明，该策略能够在保持原始重建的逼真外观的同时，适应显著的几何差异。

sents.en: The clear geometry of H-2DGS also provides a suitable foundation for deformation.
sents.zh: H-2DGS 清晰的几何结构也为形变提供了合适的基础。

sents.en: Its surface primitives retain sufficient geometric flexibility to represent substantial morphological changes, allowing deformation objectives to be defined directly on the primitive parameters and fitted to a target geometry.
sents.zh: 其表面基元保留了足够的几何灵活性，能够表示大幅度的形态变化，从而可以直接在基元参数上定义形变目标，并拟合到目标几何。

sents.en: The geometric and rendering flexibility of H-2DGS is verified in the postoperative case, where the fitting process is separated into depth-fitting and appearance-preservation stages.
sents.zh: H-2DGS 的几何与渲染灵活性在术后案例中得到了验证，其中拟合过程被分为深度拟合与外观保持两个阶段。

sents.en: The postoperative experiment demonstrates that this strategy can accommodate a pronounced geometric discrepancy while preserving the photorealistic appearance of the original reconstruction.
sents.zh: 术后实验表明，该策略能够在保持原始重建的逼真外观的同时，适应显著的几何差异。

paragraphs.en: The compact size of H-2DGS follows from its fixed 2,400-primitive budget with per-primitive texture on an explicit surface. We do not match primitive counts to the baselines, since volumetric primitives lacking local texture generally need more of them to fit the same images. Overall, the smaller footprint reflects an advantage of the height-field primitive, especially given its stronger geometric localization.
paragraphs.zh: H-2DGS 的紧凑规模源于其固定的 2,400 个图元预算，且每个图元在显式表面上带有纹理。 我们没有将图元数量与各基线方法对齐，因为缺乏局部纹理的体积图元通常需要更多的数量才能拟合同样的图像。 总体而言，更小的存储占用反映了高度场图元的优势，尤其是考虑到其更强的几何定位能力。

paragraphs.en: A remaining limitation is rendering quality. As indicated by PSNR and SSIM, H-2DGS does not reproduce the observed images as accurately as the baseline methods. Replacing volumetric support with a thin explicit surface removes geometric ambiguity, but also reduces the rendering expressiveness available for reproducing high-frequency appearance variations. We introduce spatially varying texture through the color bases to compensate for this loss, but a clear photometric gap remains. Future work should therefore investigate richer geometry-preserving appearance models that improve rendering fidelity without reintroducing diffuse volumetric opacity.
paragraphs.zh: 一个仍然存在的局限是渲染质量。 正如 PSNR 和 SSIM 所显示的那样，H-2DGS 在复现观测图像方面不如基线方法准确。 用薄的显式表面替代体积支撑消除了几何歧义，但也降低了用于复现高频外观变化的渲染表现力。 我们通过颜色基引入空间变化的纹理来弥补这一损失，但仍然存在明显的光度差距。 因此，未来的工作应研究更丰富的保几何外观模型，在不重新引入弥散体积不透明度的情况下提升渲染保真度。

paragraphs.en: The current pipeline also depends on camera poses recovered by structure from motion (SfM), whose static-scene assumption can be violated in surgical videos. One additional sequence failed because physiological cortical pulsation introduced non-rigid inter-frame motion, causing SfM to confound tissue motion with camera motion and produce inaccurate poses. This error subsequently degraded all reconstruction stages. Potential solutions include obtaining calibrated or externally tracked camera poses from specialized surgical equipment, representing each primitive’s geometric attributes as continuous functions of time, and estimating the dominant pulsation frequency for phase-aware frame selection or motion correction. Addressing both appearance expressiveness and dynamic tissue motion will be important for extending H-2DGS to more diverse surgical videos. In the future, combining this approach with cinematic rendering [ 2 , 12 ] should offer a unique opportunity to improve surgical navigation.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的流程还依赖于通过运动恢复结构（SfM）获得的相机位姿，而其静态场景假设在手术视频中可能不成立。 另有一个序列失败，原因是生理性皮层搏动引入了非刚性的帧间运动，导致 SfM 将组织运动与相机运动相混淆，产生不准确的位姿。 这一误差随后影响了所有重建阶段。 潜在的解决方案包括：从专用手术设备获取经过标定或外部跟踪的相机位姿；将每个基元的几何属性表示为随时间变化的连续函数；以及估计主要搏动频率，以实现具备相位感知的帧选择或运动校正。 同时解决外观表现力和动态组织运动问题，对于将 H-2DGS 扩展到更多样的手术视频而言将十分重要。 未来，将该方法与电影级渲染相结合 [2, 12]，应能为改进手术导航提供独特的契机。
